1.consolidated_definition: tel. Programa televisivo o radial de entrevistas a personas comunes que dan testimonio de sucesos dramáticos por los que han pasado. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Puede ser utilizado para presentar desde vídeos graciosos a programación tipo talk show y reality show (El Nuevo Día, 10-09-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Television program or radio show featuring interviews with ordinary people who provide testimony about dramatic events they have experienced.

Anglicism, often used in its raw form. It can be employed to present everything from humorous videos to talk shows and reality TV programming (El Nuevo Día, 10-09-06).
